description: List available agent/TTS voices, filtered by provider, model, gender or a text query, 50 per page by default. `total` is the number of matches before paging; use offset to see more. Use this to pick a `voice` value for create_agent/update_agent.

gender.description: Filter by voice gender, e.g. "Female" or "Male" (case-insensitive).

model_id.description: Filter to voices compatible with a given model id (matched against the voice's supported_model_ids).

provider.description: Filter to one voice provider, e.g. "elevenlabs", "sarvam", "gemini", "cartesia", "deepgram".

query.description: Case-insensitive text match against the voice label, name or id, e.g. "aditya" or "british".

workspace.description: Act in this workspace, e.g. one of your client workspaces (id from list_workspaces). Default: the workspace this connection uses.

name: list_voices
